Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.
findings.explanation: Your liability for damages has no ceiling, exposing you to unlimited financial risk if issues arise. You should negotiate a reasonable cap on your liability.
findings.suggested_change: The aggregate liability of the Contractor arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be capped at the total fees paid by the Client under this Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.
findings.explanation: Your payment is conditional on the client getting paid by a third party, which can delay your funds indefinitely. You should require payment within a fixed period after invoicing regardless of external payments.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable within 30 days after receipt of the invoice.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the liability section, the relevant clause makes your liability unlimited, which creates unnecessary financial exposure; I propose capping your aggregate liability at the total fees paid under the agreement. - Regarding the payment terms, the agreement states that your payment depends on a third party paying the client, which can cause indefinite delays; I propose that invoices are payable within 30 days after receipt of the invoice. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
